pr_comments: The change in this PR is done for `from_iter_binary_trusted_len` function, but above it you also have the `from_iter_utf8_trusted_len`, which has roughly the same implementation. Shouldn't this change not also be added to that function then?

@romanovacca Yes, thanks for pointing this. This problem indeed exists in all `from_iter_xxx_trusted_len ` methods. I will open a new PR to quick fix this. 🙇

issue_context.title: `.repeat_by` raises `PanicException` if `by=` contains nulls
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({"A": ["a", "b"], "B": [1, None]})

df.with_columns(C = pl.col("A").repeat_by("B"))
# PanicException: called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: 
# ComputeError(ErrString("validity mask length must match the number of values"))
```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

If `by=` contains nulls it raises an exception.

### Expected behavior

No exception.
